# iliad-092 — new renderings (15.92–183)

Built on the table's existing rows; the first four are new whole-line combinations that will recur.

| Greek | `l` | `i` | note |
|---|---|---|---|
| τὴν δ’ ἠμείβετ’ ἔπειτα θεὰ λευκώλενος Ἥρη (15.92, whole-line reply formula) | "Her then answered the goddess, white-armed Hera:" | "Then the goddess, white-armed Hera, answered her:" | the shipped Athena pattern (τὸν δ’ ἠμείβετ’ ἔπειτα θεὰ γλαυκῶπις Ἀθήνη) with λευκώλενος "white-armed" and "Her" |
| ἣ μὲν ἄρ’ ὣς εἰποῦσα καθέζετο / κίε πότνια Ἥρη (15.100, 15.149) | "She, indeed, then so having spoken sat down / went back, lady Hera," | "So she spoke, and lady Hera sat down / went back," | the shipped ἣ μὲν ἄρ’ ὣς εἰποῦσ’ ἀπέβη … pattern with πότνια Ἥρη "lady Hera" |
| ὣς εἰποῦσ’ ἵδρυσε θρόνῳ ἔνι θοῦρον Ἄρηα (15.142) | "So having spoken, she seated on the throne impetuous Ares." | "So she spoke, and seated impetuous Ares on the throne." | θοῦρος "impetuous" as at 5.30; ἵδρυσε "seated" |
| Ἶριν δὲ προτέρην ἔπεα πτερόεντα προσηύδα (15.157) | "And to Iris first winged words he spoke:" | "And to Iris first he spoke winged words:" | the shipped ἔπεα πτερόεντα προσηύδα pattern (iliad-021 etc.); προτέρην "first" |
| ἀγγελίην τινά (15.174) | "News, a certain piece" | "some news" | ἀγγελίη "news", as in the table |
| παυσάμενόν μιν/σ’ … ἔρχεσθαι μετὰ φῦλα θεῶν ἢ εἰς ἅλα δῖαν (15.160–161 = 176–177) | "Having ceased from battle and from war … to go among the tribes of the gods or into the heavenly brine." | "cease from battle and war, and go among the tribes of the gods or into the heavenly brine" | φῦλα θεῶν "tribes of the gods" as shipped at 15.53 (iliad-091); ἅλα δῖαν "the heavenly brine" as in the Iliad (the Odyssey's `i` "bright salt sea" is not followed) |
| κάρτεΐ τε σθένεΐ τε (15.108) | "in strength and in power" | "in strength and in power" | κάρτος "strength", σθένος "power"; βίη stays "might" |
| ἀφήμενος · ὄθεται (15.106, 107, 166, 182) | "sitting aloof" · "takes no heed" | "sits aloof" · "takes no heed" | ἀλεγίζει keeps "care for" (8.477); ὄθομαι keeps the table's "heed" (1.181, 5.403) |
| ἠλός (ἠλέ, 15.128) | "distraught" | "distraught" | meaning: crazed, out of one's wits |
| κραιπνῶς μεμαυῖα (15.172) | "so at a rush, eager" | "at a rush and in her eagerness" | the table's κραιπνῶς "at a rush" (8.247) and iliad-091 (15.83) |
| ταλάσσῃ μεῖναι (15.164) | "bring himself to await" | "bring himself to await" | the table's τλάω "bring oneself" |
| θαλερὼ μηρὼ (15.113) | "his two flourishing thighs" | "both his flourishing thighs" | θαλερός of persons/body "flourishing" |
